answer: The ripple is the proof, the horizon is what a faker must pay for, and the whisper is the record the next epoch checks. One flute maker certifies 1600 flutes a year; a farm would need 1600 forged flutes to fake one flute maker. A lip-plate strike logs the lip-plate counts, the flute totals, and the soldering dates. One real deed beats a thousand fake claims.
